definitions.explanation: The age of eight; used to state someone's age in years. Also written {8|はっ}{歳|さい} in numerals. Appears in questionnaires, forms, medical records, and everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{八歳|はっさい}です。
examples.english: My daughter is eight years old.

examples.japanese: {八歳|はっさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
{八歳|はっさい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{習|なら}い→習う：00479_narau⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I started playing the piano at age eight and still continue with it today.

examples.japanese: {八歳|はっさい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧いえば、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦{二年生|にねんせい}→二年生：27586_ninensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あたる⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧だ。
examples.english: Eight years old is the age of a second grader in elementary school in Japan.

notes:
Composed of {八|はっ} (eight) and the age counter ⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧ (also written {才|さい}). The number ⟦{八|はち}→八：00698_hachi⟧ undergoes promotion to はっ before さい, producing the sokuon (small つ) pronunciation はっさい rather than はちさい.

USAGE:
Routine vocabulary for stating ages. The counter ⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧ is used for human and animal ages; in casual writing and on children's products, the simpler {才|さい} is often substituted. Ages are typically asked with ⟦{何歳|なんさい}→何歳：17594_nansai⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (How old are you?) or the politer ⟦おいくつ→おいくつ：28149_oikutsu⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧. With the copula, one says {八歳|はっさい}だ・です.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {八歳|はっさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn eight
- {八歳|はっさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧: eighth birthday
- {八歳|はっさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧: an eight-year-old child
- {八歳|はっさい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from the age of eight

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {七歳|ななさい}: seven years old — the age before
- {九歳|きゅうさい}: nine years old — the age after
- {満|まん}{八歳|はっさい}: fully eight years old (completed years) — used on official forms
- {数|かぞ}え{八|はっ}{歳|さい}: eight by traditional counting — the older system where one is 1 at birth and gains a year at New Year
